Declare an inclusion or exclusion criterion

Source: R/cohort_criteria.R
criterion.Rd

A criterion is one stage of the cohort, evaluated in the warehouse inside the pull's transaction. Its test gives met, not met or undetermined for each unit still in the cohort. role turns that into a verdict: an "include" criterion keeps met units, and an "exclude" criterion drops them. undetermined says what happens to a unit the test cannot decide: "exclude" it, "keep" it, or send it to chart "review" (see apply_review()).

Usage

criterion(id, label, role, test, undetermined)

Arguments

id

Character. The stage id: a letter, then letters, digits or underscores.

label

Character. The CONSORT label.

role

"include" or "exclude".

test

A test from master_row(), view_rows(), any_of() or all_of().

undetermined

"exclude", "keep" or "review".

Value

An object of class cohort_criterion.

Details

No argument has a default. Which source, which window, which row and what to do without one are the study's decisions, and the pull records them.

See also

cohort_query(), local_criterion(), review_criterion()

Examples

criterion("inotrope_72h", "Any inotrope within 72 hours before surgery",
          role = "exclude",
          test = view_rows("med_admin", "given_at", c(-3, 0), "any",
                           "drug_class = 'inotrope'"),
          undetermined = "keep")
#> $id
#> [1] "inotrope_72h"
#> 
#> $label
#> [1] "Any inotrope within 72 hours before surgery"
#> 
#> $role
#> [1] "exclude"
#> 
#> $test
#> $type
#> [1] "view"
#> 
#> $view
#> [1] "med_admin"
#> 
#> $date_col
#> [1] "given_at"
#> 
#> $window
#> [1] -3  0
#> 
#> $pick
#> [1] "any"
#> 
#> $condition
#> [1] "drug_class = 'inotrope'"
#> 
#> $mrn_col
#> [1] "mrn"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "cohort_test"
#> 
#> $undetermined
#> [1] "keep"
#> 
#> $kind
#> [1] "warehouse"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "cohort_criterion"
